llm_notes: Open Library author page OL18319A: short bio, 7423 works (first 20 shown, sorted by most editions), birth/death, subject/place/people/time facets drawn from his books, ID cross-links and a long 'Alternative names' list. Many alternative names are noisy statements-of-responsibility mixing co-authors/editors (e.g. 'Mark Twain, O. Henry, Edgar Allan Poe, Jack London'); only clean name forms kept. Some 'first published' years are bogus (1817, 1758, 1800), so years omitted. 'Richmond Croom Beatty' and 'Sculley Bradley' appear as alternative names but are editors.
